karty.priklad: Dw i'n meddwl ei bod hi'n bwysig ailgylchu plastig.
karty.priklad_cs: I think it's important to recycle plastic (pwysig → [b]wysig after yn).
karty.mnemo: ail (again) + cylch (circle) = send it round the circle again.

karty.priklad: Gyrrwch yn araf i arbed petrol.
karty.priklad_cs: Drive slowly to save petrol.
karty.mnemo: ARE BED-bugs saving up? (AR-BED) – they keep their savings under the mattress.

karty.priklad: Paid â dadlau â fi – dw i'n gwybod fy mod i'n iawn!
karty.priklad_cs: Don't argue with me – I know I'm right! (bod → [m]od after fy)
karty.mnemo: DAD (DAD-lau) is arguing again.

extra.pozn: dadlau â (with someone), â causes aspirate mutation (dadlau â chi); dadlau is followed by bod (Help llaw L3)

karty.priklad: Dw i wedi clywed bod y ffatri'n cau ac yn diswyddo pawb.
karty.priklad_cs: I've heard the factory is closing and sacking everyone.
karty.mnemo: di- (without) + swydd (job) = leave someone without a job.

karty.priklad: Dw i'n pesychu drwy'r amser ers dod yn ôl.
karty.priklad_cs: I've been coughing all the time since coming back.
karty.mnemo: PESKY (PES-ychu) cough – it just won't stop.

karty.priklad: Wel, dw i'n synnu clywed hynny.
karty.priklad_cs: Well, I'm surprised to hear that.
karty.mnemo: SUNNY (SYNN-u) in Wales? Now that's a surprise!

extra.pozn: synnu is followed by bod: Dw i ddim yn synnu bod… (Help llaw L3)

karty.priklad: Mae hi'n amlwg dy fod ti wedi dysgu dy dablau'n dda.
karty.priklad_cs: It's obvious you've learnt your times tables well (tabl → [d]ablau after dy).
karty.mnemo: 'I'M LOOKING' (AM-LWG) right at it – it's obvious!

karty.priklad: Ro'n i'n sicr ein bod ni'n mynd i gael damwain – roedd hi'n annifyr iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: I was sure we were going to have an accident – it was very unpleasant.
karty.mnemo: an- (un-) + difyr (entertaining) = unpleasant.

karty.priklad: Ro'n ni'n flinedig iawn yn cyrraedd Genefa.
karty.priklad_cs: We were very tired arriving in Geneva (blinedig → [f]linedig after yn).
karty.mnemo: blino (to get tired) + -edig = tired.

extra.pozn: check against the PDF: the phrase 'yn cyrraedd' (colloquially more likely wrth gyrraedd / pan gyrhaeddon ni)

karty.priklad: Sut roedd yr ystafell? Ro'n i'n meddwl ei bod hi'n gyfforddus.
karty.priklad_cs: How was the room? I thought it was comfortable (cyfforddus → [g]yfforddus after yn).
karty.mnemo: English 'comfort' → CYFFORDD-us.

karty.priklad: Dw i'n meddwl ei fod e'n gymhleth.
karty.priklad_cs: I think it's complicated (cymhleth → [g]ymhleth after yn).
karty.mnemo: COMPLETE (CYMHL-eth) chaos – that's complicated.

sever.priklad: Dw i'n meddwl ei fod o'n gymhleth.
sever.priklad_cs: I think it's complicated (cymhleth → [g]ymhleth after yn).

karty.priklad: Dw i'n meddwl ei bod hi'n ddifyr.
karty.priklad_cs: I think it's entertaining (difyr → [dd]ifyr after yn; ffilm is feminine in Welsh → ei bod hi).
karty.mnemo: DIVER (DIF-yr) doing tricks off the pier – very entertaining.

karty.priklad: Dw i'n meddwl ei fod e'n ddigalon.
karty.priklad_cs: I think it's disheartening (digalon → [dd]igalon after yn).
karty.mnemo: di- (without) + calon (heart) = without heart.

sever.priklad: Dw i'n meddwl ei fod o'n ddigalon.
sever.priklad_cs: I think it's disheartening (digalon → [dd]igalon after yn).

karty.priklad: Mae'n bosib eich bod chi angen paned o goffi enfawr nawr!
karty.priklad_cs: Maybe you need a huge cup of coffee now! (coffi → [g]offi after o)
karty.mnemo: en- (very) + mawr (big) = huge.

sever.priklad: Mae'n bosib eich bod chi angen paned o goffi enfawr rŵan!
sever.priklad_cs: Maybe you need a huge cup of coffee now! (coffi → [g]offi after o)

karty.priklad: Roedd hi'n rhewllyd iawn, felly roedd y ffordd yn llithrig.
karty.priklad_cs: It was very icy, so the road was slippery (ll does not mutate after yn).
karty.mnemo: llithro (to slip, to slide) + -ig = slippery.

karty.priklad: Roedd hi'n rhewllyd iawn ar y mynydd.
karty.priklad_cs: It was very icy on the mountain (rh does not mutate after yn).
karty.mnemo: rhew = ice, frost (rhewi = to freeze).

karty.priklad: Ro'n i'n meddwl dy fod ti'n cerdded yn rhyfedd.
karty.priklad_cs: I thought you were walking strangely.
karty.mnemo: 'RIVER FED?' (RHY-FEDD) – how strange: someone's throwing bread into the river.

karty.priklad: Roedd y ffordd yn serth iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: The road was very steep.
karty.mnemo: Your SHIRT (SERTH) is soaked through after cycling up such a steep hill.

karty.priklad: Stopiodd y car yn sydyn.
karty.priklad_cs: The car stopped suddenly (yn sydyn = suddenly).
karty.mnemo: SUDDEN = SYDYN: almost the same word.

karty.priklad: Llenwch y ffurflen gais, os gwelwch yn dda.
karty.priklad_cs: Please fill in the application form.
karty.mnemo: ffurflen = form, cais = application (→ gais after the feminine ffurflen).

extra.pozn: listed under 'arall' in the Geirfa box; feminine (like ffurflen); pl. ffurflenni cais (not in the coursebook)

karty.priklad: Dw i'n byw oddi cartre ers dwy flynedd.
karty.priklad_cs: I've been living away from home for two years (blynedd → [f]lynedd after dwy).
karty.mnemo: cartre(f) = home; oddi = from.

karty.priklad: Dyma ragor: hapus, hyderus, lwcus.
karty.priklad_cs: Here are some more: happy, confident, lucky (rhagor → [r]agor after dyma).
karty.mnemo: Oliver Twist in RAGs (RHAG-or) holds up his bowl: 'Please, sir, I want some more!'

extra.pozn: the coursebook gives mwy as a synonym (for quantity only)

karty.cs: on the corner of your street
karty.priklad: Mae siop fach ar gornel eich stryd chi.
karty.priklad_cs: There's a little shop on the corner of your street (cornel → [g]ornel after ar).

karty.priklad: Sori! Wnaiff e ddim digwydd eto.
karty.priklad_cs: Sorry! It won't happen again (gwneud → [w]naiff in the negative).

extra.pozn: colloquially in the south also Wneith e ddim… (not in the coursebook)

sever.priklad: Sori! Wnaiff o ddim digwydd eto.
